text: Renata asked for something 'reliable.' That's not a requirement yet -- it's an intention. This video turns it into numbers pulled straight from the Lesson 1 incident, not invented from scratch.
Recovery Point Objective: five minutes or less. Recovery Time Objective: under fifteen minutes, through a tested failover -- not the multi-hour manual restore Carl described dry-running.
Those targets aren't arbitrary. Fifteen-minute log backups already proved tolerable, and at roughly 2,400 claims a day, every hour of downtime is about 300 claims that can't be filed.

Security gets the same treatment: Azure AD authentication, least-privilege access review on Carl's own long-standing permissions, encryption at rest and in transit, and auditable logs -- each one checkable, not just promised.
The targets are set. Next: drawing a hard line around what phase one actually delivers.
